data.one_liner: Extended camera plugin with native aspect ratio support for iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: A fork of the official camera package that adds sensor-level aspect ratio configuration (16:9, 4:3, 1:1). It maintains full API compatibility with the original camera plugin while providing native aspect ratio selection on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need native aspect ratio control such as 1:1 square or 4:3 photos.
You are migrating from the official camera package and want sensor-level ratio settings.
avoid_when: You need features completely unrelated to camera captures or previews.
strengths: Native aspect ratio selection including 1:1, 4:3, and 16:9.
API-compatible drop-in replacement for the official camera package.
Sensor-level configuration for Android and iOS.
weaknesses: 1:1 format falls back to 4:3 on iOS due to native limitations.
Fork of another package, requiring you to trust maintenance of the fork.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera and microphone permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer using the official and standard Flutter camera package without custom aspect ratio extensions.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: You specifically need barcode and QR code scanning rather than a general-purpose photo and video camera.
